decisions.decision: The minutes of August 8, 2018 were not ready; no approval was taken.
Write-ins language is to go back on the agenda for later discussion, put there by Bob.
decisions.quote: bob to put this back on our agenda.

decisions.decision: Bob will add a ranked choice voting presenter to the schedule and agenda.
decisions.quote: bob said we should consider having someone come in to present on the topic and he would add it to our schedule and agenda.

decisions.decision: A proposed draft will be published in advance of any public hearing.
decisions.quote: we will publish a proposed draft in advance of any public hearing.

decisions.decision: Public hearings are to be scheduled, with the first the week of 11/26 depending on Town Hall availability and the second the week of Jan 21; the committee would then appear before the BOS in early February.
decisions.quote: the first public hearing would be the week of 11/26 depending on availability of town hall

decisions.decision: Invite Carl and Phyllis Luck, Heather, the park, cemetery and sewer groups, and the Library to meet with the committee; review whether the Housing Authority is following the charter.
decisions.quote: we talked about inviting various parties to meet with us and getting them on the schedule:

decisions.decision: Bob will provide a clean copy of the proposed changes at the next meeting.
decisions.quote: bob said he would provide a clean copy at our next meeting.

decisions.decision: Separate votes will be taken on corrections, non-controversial changes and controversial changes, each individually, as the way Town Meeting is run requires; both sides of any change will be presented at the public hearings.
decisions.quote: the plan is to have separate votes on corrections, non-controversial change and controversial changes, each individually.

decisions.decision: The next meeting is set for September 12.
